pages.text: While turning Villagers into Witches is a well known science, you wondered how to make Witch that serves you. Fortunately some Soul Energy, and a lot of Emeralds and a Mystic Core, allows one to make a loyal Witch.

You're also able to trade with your Witch Servant by giving them an Emerald, without needing to wear appropriate attire to do so. You can also trade with other Witch Servants, provided you're allied to their master, if they have one, and wearing the appropriate attire.
